title_i18n.zh: Anthropic 研究：AI 编程辅助使开发者技能掌握度下降 17%
title_i18n.en: Anthropic study: AI coding assistance reduces developer skill proficiency by 17%.
title_i18n.es: Estudio de Anthropic: La asistencia de programación con IA reduce el dominio de habilidades de los desarrolladores en un 17%.

excerpt_i18n.zh: Anthropic 近日发布了一项随机对照试验，结果显示，使用 AI 编程辅助工具的开发者在理解能力测试中的得分比手动编程的开发者低 17%，且其生产力方面的提升未达到统计显著性。
excerpt_i18n.en: Anthropic recently released a randomized controlled trial showing that developers using AI programming assistants scored 17% lower on comprehension tests compared to those coding manually, while their productivity gains did not reach statistical significance.
excerpt_i18n.es: Anthropic publicó recientemente un ensayo controlado aleatorio que reveló que los desarrolladores que utilizan herramientas de asistencia de programación con IA obtuvieron un 17% menos de puntuación en pruebas de comprensión en comparación con quienes programan manualmente, y la mejora en su productividad no alcanzó significación estadística.

items.title: How are engineering teams handling AI compliance?
items.raw_excerpt: Companies are adopting AI tools fast, but I keep wondering about the human side of it — not whether the tools work, but whether engineers actually know what they're and aren't allowed to do with them. Specific things I'm curious about: does your company have real AI usage policy or is it "use common sense"? Has anything gone wrong — data sent somewhere it shouldn't, AI used in an auditable decision with no trail? And if someone asked you today whether your team is compliant with AI Act or SOC2 in how they use AI — could you actually answer that?

items.title: 阿里巴巴AI品牌统一为千问
items.raw_excerpt: 3月2日，记者获悉，阿里巴巴集团内部将 AI 的总称和核心品牌统一为千问，千问大模型（Qwen）涵盖基础大模型和专业领域模型，千问APP是阿里巴巴在C端的旗舰AI应用。据悉，此举是为了避免之前千问、通义千问、Qwen 等多个名称导致的混淆问题，统一名称之后，阿里巴巴大模型品牌中文为“千问大模型”，英文为“Qwen”，“通义实验室”为阿里巴巴集团旗下AI机构的组织名称。   据了解，今年除夕，千问3.5开源发布，后陆续开源多款中小型Qwen3.5模型，性能强、效率高，包揽Hugging Face全球开源大模型榜前4，成为当前全球AI社区最受追捧的大模型。春节期间，用户在千问APP上“一句话下单”近2亿次，Questmobile数据显示，千问在春节期间DAU达到7352万，以940%增幅居国内AI应用首位，千问一跃成为国民级AI助手。

excerpt_i18n.es: El 2 de marzo, se informó que Alibaba Group ha unificado internamente la denominación general y la marca central de su IA bajo el nombre "Qianwen". El modelo de gran escala Qianwen (Qwen) abarca tanto modelos base como especializados en áreas específicas, y la aplicación Qianwen APP es la principal herramienta de IA de Alibaba para usuarios finales. excerpt_i18n.en:
Over the past three years, AI applications have continuously "broken through" from the lab to everyday life. Whether it's the stunning debut of ChatGPT, the impressive launch of DeepSeek, or tools like Cursor and Lovable enabling entrepreneurs with no coding background to build products, and even Clawbot evolving from concept to usability, the changes in this wave of AI applications are being amplified. However, to date, AI primarily addresses efficiency issues, leaving a truly blank space for another, more challenging question: as tools become increasingly powerful, how should I navigate the rest of my life?  

Against this backdrop, the emergence of the AI application NOOK stands out as somewhat different. On NOOK's interface, users enter their birth time, location, and gender, after which NOOK's proprietary numerical system performs a cold-start profile. Then, an AI called Life Copilot proactively recommends goals and tasks to users—ranging from weight loss and skill acquisition to career planning and personal growth.  

What NOOK aims to achieve is the second stage of AI applications—evolving from efficiency tools to life operating systems. These goals are not left at an abstract level but are broken down into actionable daily tasks.
